_what: The words and rules of the widgets a recording in progress shows wherever the person is (DATA, read by show/recording-notices.ts, show/RecordingPill.tsx and show/processing-steps.ts). card: the notification kept while a recording runs (title is the meeting's own title when the recording belongs to one, else `adhoc_title`; `detail` is said by phase; each action is a button on it, `when` the phases it shows in, `phase` the recording phases it is offered in). preparing: the card shown from Stop until the recording is kept, and `ready` / `failed` the cards that end it. pill: the small dark pill with the time, Stop and the microphone menu that shows while this window is not the one in front (`shown_when`: `window-not-focused`); `microphone_preference` is the saved preference the chosen microphone is kept in, `default_microphone` the menu's first row; a microphone chosen while a recording runs is fed into it at once with no gap (`microphone_now` heads the menu then) and is also kept for the next recording, and one that cannot be opened leaves the recording on the microphone it had (`microphone_not_changed`). The pill is drawn on the look's island ground (dark in every look). window: where an app that hosts this page floats the pill over other apps (Trillion for Mac, macos/App/RecordingWindow.swift, which bundles this file): the page opens `address` (named `name`) only when the host offers the `channel` message handler, draws the pill in it, and tells the host its size through `channel` ({ kind: 'size', width, height }, points); the host shows exactly that, centred `below_menu_bar` points under the menu bar of the screen in use, over every app and space, and closes it when the page closes it. `width` and `height` are its first size; while the microphone menu is open it is `menu_width` by `menu_height`, so the menu opens inside it. adhoc_title is also the name of the note made the moment a recording starts without a meeting; the note keeps what the person types while recording. steps: the stages a kept recording goes through, in order, each read from a fact the screen holds (`fact`), looked at again every `look_again_ms` while the words are being made, drawn as hollow while waiting, turning while working and checked when done.

preparing.title: Preparing meeting note
preparing.failed: The recording could not be kept

pill.label: Recording
pill.microphone_now: Changes the microphone now, without stopping
pill.microphone_not_changed: That microphone could not be opened, so the recording goes on with the one it had.
